Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 117 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Enveloppe globale du Plan de Prévention du Risque Inondation (PPRI) de; Communes de l'atlas des zones inondables et des plans de prévention de; PPRi du Val du Louet et de la Confluence de la Maine et de la Loire; Tronçons de cours d'eau réglementaires surveillés par les services de . Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
